_comment: Tier-2 for kratos plasticity#: catalog yield_surfaces list contains Rankine + SimoJu, implying SmallStrainIsotropicPlasticity3DRankineRankine and SmallStrainIsotropicPlasticity3DSimoJuSimoJu exist via the documented <StrainSize><HardeningType><Dimension><YieldSurface><PlasticPotential> pattern. They DON'T — Rankine and SimoJu are exclusively damage models (SmallStrainDplusDminusDamageRankineRankine3D etc., or SmallStrainIsotropicDamage3DRankine), not plasticity classes. The other 5 catalog yield surfaces (VonMises, Tresca, DruckerPrager, MohrCoulomb, ModifiedMohrCoulomb) DO combine correctly. Verified empirically 2026-06-01 (Kratos 10.4.2 + KratosConstitutiveLawsApplication 10.4.2). MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 probes the five REGISTERED plasticity class names in place of the five nonexistent Rankine/SimoJu ones; every probed name then resolves on CLA, which also proves the probe really consults the module surface. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all_plasticity_rankine_simoju_missing=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/plasticity_rankine_simoju_are_damage_only && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
